CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.append_pharmflow_cloud_transaction(p_pharmacy_id uuid, p_transaction_id text, p_order_number text, p_item_code text, p_item_name text, p_gtin text, p_quantity numeric, p_source text, p_device_id text, p_occurred_at timestamp with time zone, p_payload jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
    if not public.pharmflow_can_access_pharmacy(p_pharmacy_id) then raise exception 'Pharmacy access required'; end if;
    insert into public.pharmflow_cloud_transactions(pharmacy_id,transaction_id,order_number,item_code,item_name,gtin,quantity,source,device_id,occurred_at,payload)
    values(p_pharmacy_id,p_transaction_id,p_order_number,p_item_code,p_item_name,p_gtin,coalesce(p_quantity,0),p_source,p_device_id,coalesce(p_occurred_at,now()),coalesce(p_payload,'{}'::jsonb))
    on conflict(pharmacy_id,transaction_id) do nothing;
end;$function$
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bulk_upsert_session_items(p_session_id uuid, p_session_secret uuid, p_items jsonb)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
    v_count integer := 0;
begin
    if not exists (
        select 1 from public.sessions s
        where s.id = p_session_id
          and s.session_secret = p_session_secret
          and s.status = 'active'
    ) then
        raise exception 'Invalid or inactive session';
    end if;

    insert into public.session_items (
        session_id, item_code, item_name, gtin, gtins, category, ordered_qty
    )
    select
        p_session_id,
        x.item_code,
        x.item_name,
        x.gtin,
        coalesce(x.gtins,'[]'::jsonb),
        x.category,
        coalesce(x.ordered_qty,0)
    from jsonb_to_recordset(coalesce(p_items,'[]'::jsonb)) as x(
        item_code text,
        item_name text,
        gtin text,
        gtins jsonb,
        category text,
        ordered_qty numeric
    )
    where nullif(trim(x.item_code),'') is not null
    on conflict (session_id,item_code)
    do update set
        item_name = excluded.item_name,
        gtin = excluded.gtin,
        gtins = excluded.gtins,
        category = excluded.category,
        ordered_qty = excluded.ordered_qty;

    get diagnostics v_count = row_count;
    return v_count;
end;
$function$
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_pharmacy_admin_assignment()
 RETURNS TABLE(pharmacy_id uuid, pharmacy_code text, pharmacy_name text, member_role text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
    v_email text;
    v_assignment public.pharmacy_admin_assignments%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
    IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required';
    END IF;

    SELECT lower(u.email)
    INTO v_email
    FROM auth.users u
    WHERE u.id = v_user_id;

    IF v_email IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authenticated user email not found';
    END IF;

    /*
      Find the ADMIN assignment for this email.

      We allow:
      - pending assignment
      - already claimed by the same user

      This makes the function safe to call on every Sign In.
    */
    SELECT paa.*
    INTO v_assignment
    FROM public.pharmacy_admin_assignments paa
    WHERE lower(paa.email) = v_email
      AND (
            paa.status = 'pending'
            OR (
                paa.status = 'claimed'
                AND paa.claimed_by = v_user_id
            )
          )
    ORDER BY paa.assigned_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    /*
      Pharmacy must still be active.
    */
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.pharmacies p
        WHERE p.id = v_assignment.pharmacy_id
          AND p.active = true
          AND p.status = 'active'
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Assigned pharmacy is not active';
    END IF;

    /*
      Only one normal ADMIN per pharmacy.
      System Owner membership is never disabled here.
    */
    UPDATE public.pharmacy_members pm
    SET active = false
    WHERE pm.pharmacy_id = v_assignment.pharmacy_id
      AND pm.role = 'admin'
      AND pm.active = true
      AND pm.user_id <> v_user_id
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM public.system_owners so
          WHERE so.user_id = pm.user_id
      );

    /*
      Ensure user profile exists.
    */
    INSERT INTO public.profiles (
        user_id,
        email,
        display_name
    )
    VALUES (
        v_user_id,
        v_email,
        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT u.raw_user_meta_data->>'display_name'
                FROM auth.users u
                WHERE u.id = v_user_id
            ),
            split_part(v_email, '@', 1)
        )
    )
    ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT profiles_pkey
    DO UPDATE SET
        email = EXCLUDED.email,
        display_name = COALESCE(
            NULLIF(public.profiles.display_name, ''),
            EXCLUDED.display_name
        ),
        updated_at = now();

    /*
      Create or reactivate pharmacy ADMIN membership.
    */
    INSERT INTO public.pharmacy_members (
        pharmacy_id,
        user_id,
        role,
        active
    )
    VALUES (
        v_assignment.pharmacy_id,
        v_user_id,
        'admin',
        true
    )
    ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT pharmacy_members_pharmacy_id_user_id_key
    DO UPDATE SET
        role = 'admin',
        active = true;

    /*
      Mark assignment as claimed.
    */
    UPDATE public.pharmacy_admin_assignments paa
    SET
        status = 'claimed',
        claimed_by = v_user_id,
        claimed_at = COALESCE(paa.claimed_at, now())
    WHERE paa.id = v_assignment.id;

    /*
      Return the pharmacy context to Medryvo.
    */
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        p.id,
        p.code,
        p.name,
        'admin'::text
    FROM public.pharmacies p
    WHERE p.id = v_assignment.pharmacy_id;
END;
$function$
;

 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select c.job_id, c.pharmacy_id, c.review_id, c.operation_id,
         c.object_path, c.attempts, c.claim_token
  from pharmflow_expiry_private.claim_photo_cleanup_jobs(p_limit) as c;
